Privacy Policy

Last updated: 2025

Welcome to Vinoandco Events, located at www.vinoandco.events (“website”). This Privacy Policy explains how Vinoandco Events (“we”, “company”) collects, uses, protects, and processes information about you when you visit our website or use our services, including purchases, content, and event registrations (“services”).

By using this website, you agree to this Privacy Policy and our Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use the website.

1. What Data We Collect and Process

1.1 Overview

We may process the following categories of personal data:

  • Data you provide directly to us
  • Data automatically collected through analytics
  • Data submitted when making purchases or filling out forms
  • Data provided when subscribing to newsletters
  • Transaction and payment-related data
  • Data required to comply with legal obligations

1.2 Account Data

When you create an account or make a purchase, we may collect:

  • Name
  • Email address
  • Phone number (if needed for registration)

Account data is used to operate the website, manage your purchases, provide services, and communicate with you.

1.3 Usage Data

We may process information about how you use the website, including:

  • IP address
  • Browser type and version
  • Device and operating system
  • Geographic location
  • Pages viewed and navigation paths
  • Visit duration

This data is collected via analytics tools.

1.4 Publication Data

If you post content on our website, such as comments, we may process this data to publish and administer it.

1.5 Inquiry Data

When you submit a contact form or request, we may process:

  • Name
  • Email
  • Message content

1.6 Transaction Data

We process data related to event ticket purchases, including order information. Payments are handled directly by payment providers such as Stripe or PayPal. We do not store your credit card or banking information.

1.7 Notification Data

If you subscribe to newsletters or updates, we process your email and notification preferences.

1.8 Legal Claims

We may process data when necessary for legal claims, compliance, or protection of rights.

1.9 Vital Interests

We may process your data when necessary to protect your life or the life of another person.

2. How We Share Information

2.1 Hosting

Your data is stored on secure servers of our hosting providers.

2.2 Third-Party Service Providers

We may share your data with trusted service providers for:

  • Hosting
  • Email communications
  • Analytics
  • Customer support
  • Payment processing
  • Ticketing systems and API integrations

2.3 Business Transfers

If we undergo a merger, acquisition, or reorganization, your data may be transferred.

2.4 Legal Requirements

We may disclose data to comply with legal obligations or protect rights and safety.

2.5 With Your Consent

We may share data outside this policy only with your explicit consent.

2.6 Updating or Deleting Data

You may request updates or deletion of your data via your account or by contacting us.

3. Data Retention

3.1 General Rules

We retain data as long as necessary for service delivery, legal compliance, and security.

3.2 Specific Retention Periods

  • Usage data: up to 1 month after subscription ends
  • Account data: up to 1 month after account deletion
  • Publication data: up to 1 month after removal
  • Inquiry data: up to 1 month after response
  • Transaction data: up to 1 month after order completion
  • Notification data: up to 1 month after unsubscribing

4. Security

We take industry-standard measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, loss, or alteration. However, no method of online transmission is 100% secure.

5. Your Rights Under EU Law (GDPR)

  • Right of access
  • Right to rectification
  • Right to erasure
  • Right to restrict processing
  • Right to object
  • Right to data portability
  • Right to withdraw consent anytime
  • Right to lodge a complaint with a data authority

6. Cookie Policy

6.1 What Are Cookies

Cookies are small text files stored on your device to improve website experience.

6.2 Types of Cookies We Use

  • Authentication cookies
  • Preference cookies
  • Security cookies
  • Analytics cookies (Google Analytics)
  • Advertising cookies

6.3 Google Analytics

Google may store and process data on servers in the United States. Learn more: Google Privacy Policy

7. How to Control Cookies

You may block or delete cookies through your browser settings:

  • Chrome
  • Firefox
  • Safari
  • Edge

8. Revisions and Severability

We may update this Privacy Policy by publishing a new version on this website. If any part is found unlawful, the remaining parts remain in effect.
